## Maintainer approval

This project is open source, not open contribution. Unsolicited pull requests
are not accepted. Email the maintainer and obtain co-maintainer approval first;
see [contribution policy](../CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Approved change

- Problem and resulting behavior:
- Related issue:
- Exact scope and exclusions:
- Source/reference evidence:
- Acceptance command, result and negative case:
- Relevant local quality/regression checks:
- Remaining NOT_RUN platforms/modes:
- Component license/attribution review:

All commits require DCO sign-off. A pull request does not authorize publication,
hosted release workflows, tags or public promotion. There is no constitutional
5MB binary-size or universal-startup guarantee.
